title: tgden — Telegram catalog & search
description: Search 1.2M+ public Telegram channels, 245k+ group chats and 160k+ bots by topic — including full-text search over what those channels actually posted, and a regional classifieds market. Finds public communities you have NOT joined. No Telegram account, no API key, no install.
